scope: Independent read-only adversarial review of PresetCharacterTests.cpp before local-window reconstruction hardening
decision: No remaining blocking math or assertion defect identified after root accepted local-window reconstruction hardening and Pure mode documentation correction.

accepted_findings.finding: Full-capture reconstruction tolerance can dilute a mismatch confined to the 4–20 ms strike measurement window. A local 8% error over 16 ms of a constant-energy 1.2-second capture contributes only about 0.924% globally.
accepted_findings.recommendation: Check reconstruction in each measured onset/held window using already rendered samples; no new audio render needed.

accepted_findings.finding: Pure CS-80 masks both rank pans to zero, so the newly authored stereo spread applies to ordinary Circuit mode, not isolation.
accepted_findings.recommendation: Explicitly state that Pure centers these programs; preserve tag vocabulary and existing usesModernLayer contract.

verified_reasoning: Actual full factory voices are rendered; tests do not assert authored parameter values.
Ranks stay active and are isolated only by the actual mix control; float32 body weighting matches Engine subtraction.
Finite and full-scale guards plus minimum body/window energy prevent silence and NaN false passes.
Hann DFT power, stereo average, mono (L+R)/2, and power-to-dB conversion are internally consistent.
The 16-foot Brass Ensemble main band correctly uses half MIDI60 frequency; other tested main registers are 8-foot.
Correlation rejects simple L/R gain imbalance as a substitute for stereo information.
Thresholds have broad margins and demonstrably reject the frozen weaker bank; they are authoring contracts rather than perceptual hearing thresholds.
limits: These tests cover 11 named programs at one note/velocity, no pressure, and one sample rate. Ether Pad is covered by authoring measurements, not this new CI target.
Amplitude and stereo-role checks do not prove acoustic timbre identity or hardware equivalence.
The local-window hardening has not been rerun by this reviewer; parent will verify final integrated result.
